# AWS Shield Advanced

Store Shield Advanced subscriptions, protections and protection groups without attack detection or mitigation.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `shield` |
| Signing name | `shield` |
| Wire protocol | AWS JSON 1.1 |
| API version | `2016-06-02` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Records only |
| Selected operations | 33 of 36 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#aws-shield-advanced) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- No attack detection, traffic inspection, mitigation, SRT calls, IAM policy evaluation, support-plan checks or DDoS cost protection; attack lists and statistics are empty and unknown attacks fail.
- Application layer automatic response operations and WAFv2 integration are unsupported.
- Network Load Balancers are protected through their Elastic IP allocations, as on AWS; direct NLB ARNs are unsupported.
- Subscriptions cannot be deleted; DeleteSubscription returns LockedSubscriptionException. No billing or automatic renewal scheduler runs.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
